reserveReview.rationale: Write-time Ethereum reads at block 25648096 (2026-07-30) on canonical USD3 0x056b269eb1f75477a8666ae8c7fe01b64dd55ecc resolved nav(), totalAssets(), totalSupply(), USD3 waUSDC accounting, Aave market liquidity, availableWithdrawLimit(address(0)), minCommitmentTime(), isShutdown(), and USD3's USDC balance. The adapter-valued snapshot resolves 90.8% Fintech and crypto credit receivables and 9.2% Aave USDC liquidity buffer, with no idle USDC, zero minimum commitment time, and isShutdown=false. 3Jane's current backing and supplier disclosures independently describe the two credit sleeves (Fintech Credit Conduits and Crypto Credit Lines) and idle USDC supplied to the Aave V3 USDC market. The on-chain snapshot supplies the dated weights; the issuer disclosure supplies the honest group identities and the immediate-liquidity claim.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Canonical USD3 on-chain accounting, valued through its waUSDC position and the Aave V3 USDC market at Ethereum block 25648096; issuer documentation for the backing-sleeve identities.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The retained July 30 on-chain composition emits one combined credit-receivables group. Source recovery on 2026-10-20 supersedes the earlier blanket statement that public sleeve and facility weights are absent: the issuer backing dashboard now discloses separate money-market, Erebor staging, warehouse, forward-flow and credit-line categories and named LendSwift, Slope and Settle facilities. The recovered source payload has query dataUpdatedAt values around 2026-10-20T22:24:47Z, while its facility carrying rows retain October 16, October 15 and October 14 as-of dates respectively. Warehouse collateral value is not its carrying claim; TVV includes credit enhancement and is not the reserve-claim denominator. Those distinct scopes/clocks cannot be normalized into a current whole-book split or backdated into the July composition. A producer/accounting integration remains required before narrowing the combined adapter exposure. Complete merchant/facility contractual maturity maxima and whole-position realization bounds remain unestablished.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The retained adapter snapshot emits one combined credit-receivables value. October 20 source recovery establishes that the issuer now publishes named sleeve/facility breakdowns, but those mixed-date carrying, collateral and verified-backing figures have not been reconciled to the exact adapter reserve denominator. The basket-needs-split disposition therefore remains an integration/accounting gap, not a blanket claim that all facility weights are undisclosed. No narrower dependency, obligor weight or contractual maturity is inferred, and the historical composition/review dates and percentages are preserved.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 3Jane identifies its Erebor account for off-ramped staging cash, disbursements, and collections, and Aave V3 for idle USDC. Facility-level bankruptcy-remote SPVs are described, but no pool-wide segregation, holder bankruptcy-remoteness, rehypothecation terms, complete custody-provider roster, or sourced provider shares are established. Facility originators and borrower asset-proof platforms are not treated as pool custodians.
